name: Bogotá (Chapinero, Usaquén), Colombia

rent.notes: Pet-friendly 2-3BR in Chapinero/Usaquen: Portafolio (Oct 2026, Fincaraiz data) gives Usaquen average 4.6M COP and Chapinero Alto 2BR 2.5-4.7M COP; Numbeo 3BR centre 3.53M (2.4-6.76M, flagged as lower bound). Typical ~4.2M COP incl. admin. USD at ~3,200 COP/USD (TRM early Nov 2026).

utilities.notes: Electricity, gas, water, sewer, trash for a 2-3BR estrato 4-6 unit; Numbeo basic utilities 85m2 336,389 COP (229k-618k), scaled up slightly for size; no heating/cooling load. Excludes internet. USD at ~3,200 COP/USD (TRM early Nov 2026).

healthcare.notes: Full health-coverage cost for 2 resident retirees age 60: EPS contributory affiliation (~12.5% of declared income, roughly $60-150 each in source at 4,050 COP) plus prepagada top-up (Colsanitas/Sura/Coomeva, $80-200 each depending on age, upper end at 60); converted at the stronger peso. Absorbs the old-template health figure previously stored under insurance. Anti-VEGF/GLP-1 notes from stored record still apply.

insurance.notes: OLD-TEMPLATE RULE: stored 200 was health insurance; re-modeled to renters/contents placeholder (contents policies are uncommon/cheap in Colombia). Not verified; health cost moved into healthcare.

transportation.notes: Car-free: 2 TransMilenio/SITP monthly equivalents (Numbeo 160,000 COP each) plus app taxis; max reflects car ownership ($200-350 at 4,050 COP per EscapeFromUSA). Senior (62+) fare discounts not verified. USD at ~3,200 COP/USD (TRM early Nov 2026).
